    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Brush
    Enumeration of toothbrush types used to fill gaps.
    BrushPanel
    A panel for displaying and selecting toothbrush types.
    CommentPanel
     
    CommentTextArea
    A text area for a comment with a fixed number of rows and columns.
    DentalPanel
    The main panel displays the upper and lower jaws with teeth and spaces, as well as a comment field.
    DentalScheme
    The main class of the application, representing the main window of the dental scheme.
    Mouth
    A class representing a model of the oral cavity: contains all the teeth and the spaces between them.
    Space
    A class representing the space between two adjacent teeth.
    TextLimitDocumentFilter
    A document filter that limits the input text by character and line count.
    ToolPanel
    A toolbar containing action buttons (for example, printing a diagram).
    Tooth
    A class representing a tooth in a dental schema.
